status_note: Promoted on 2026-09-28 as the E31 reference with the measured switch defaults: tail ring on (VLLM_GLM53_KPOOL_TAIL_RING unset = 1), head gate off (VLLM_GLM53_INDEXER_GATE_TC unset = 0; its A/B is unresolved). cluster.env.example mounts both files and names both flag files; the overlay refuses the E31 default, apply it on scripts/node/reference/baseline-20260925-e29.env to reproduce the measured load.
summary: E29 plus two runtime-selectable indexer changes. (1) Head gate on tensor cores: with its flag at 1, the per-layer head gate (N=32 index heads, K=4096) is a BF16 tensor-core GEMM with FP32 accumulation and FP32 output, replacing the FP32 SIMT GEMM and the BF16-to-FP32 copy of hidden_states; the products are unchanged and only the accumulation order differs, which can reorder near-tie pool selections. (2) Speculative-safe C4 tail ring (fix candidate, on by default in the overlay): the per-request key/gate tail that completes four-token pools had four slots indexed by position % 4, so the rows of a DFlash verify step (1 + K positions, including drafts that may be rejected) overwrote committed members of the still-open pool, and the next step completed that pool from rejected-draft keys. The ring has 4 * cdiv(4 + K, 4) slots (12 for K = 7) indexed by position % ring, while the ape/pool phase stays position % 4; no row of one step can then reach a committed member of the open pool.

pooled_indexer.py.change: The production pooled_indexer.py plus pooled_indexer.patch, which adds lines and replaces only the _tail shape. _project_head_weights calls torch.mm(hidden_states, W.t(), out_dtype=torch.float32) when the switch is on and both operands are BF16; the first call probes out_dtype, and a TypeError or RuntimeError disables the path for the process with a warning. Otherwise it runs the unchanged FP32 path. VLLM_GLM53_INDEXER_GATE_TC (0 or 1, read at import, default 0) is the default; when VLLM_GLM53_INDEXER_GATE_TC_FLAG is set, the named file's content 1 or 0 overrides it, re-read at most every 0.5 s with a monotonic clock; a missing or unreadable file, or other content, means the default. With VLLM_GLM53_INDEXER_GATE_TC_FLAG unset there is no file access. The forward is @eager_break_during_capture, which the image's breakable_cudagraph re-runs eagerly on every graph replay, so a change applies without recapture. The tail (and its MTP snapshot) holds 4 * cdiv(4 + K, 4) slots for K = speculative_config.num_speculative_tokens (4 without speculation); VLLM_GLM53_KPOOL_TAIL_RING (default 1, flag file VLLM_GLM53_KPOOL_TAIL_RING_FLAG, same semantics) passes that ring, or 4 for the legacy mapping, to update_decode_pools on every forward and logs E31_KPOOL_TAIL_RING ring=<n> on each change. Switch it only while no request is running.

glm_kpool.py.change: The production glm_kpool.py plus glm_kpool.patch: a runtime int argument tail_ring for _decode_update_kernel, _prefill_pool_kernel and _prefill_tail_kernel and update_decode_pools(..., tail_ring=4), validated against the tail capacity. Tail stores use position % tail_ring; decode pool reads use (pool_start + slot) % tail_ring with pool_start = position - position % 4; prefill pool reads of members before the chunk use (completion_position - 3 + slot) % tail_ring; the ape and pool phase stay position % 4. With tail_ring = 4 every index equals the legacy one. Six tail-offset lines are replaced; the rest is added.

flags.VLLM_GLM53_INDEXER_GATE_TC_FLAG: /tmp/glm53-indexer-gate-tc inside the container; written with docker exec, no bind mount
flags.VLLM_GLM53_KPOOL_TAIL_RING: unset (1, E31 ring) in the overlay
flags.VLLM_GLM53_KPOOL_TAIL_RING_FLAG: /tmp/glm53-kpool-tail-ring inside the container; switch only while no request is running

leaf_test: leaf_gate_tc.py: single-GPU, Torch-only comparison of both head-gate paths (error, top-512 pool-selection proxy, eager, CUDA-graph and alternating A/B timings). leaf_kpool_tail_ring.py: the E31 Triton kernels with production page geometry (2304-token parent pages with their FP8 index tail), several requests in mixed decode-then-prefill batches with non-contiguous state slots, chunked prefill and DFlash-style verify steps with rejections; committed pools are compared with a prefill over the committed tokens and, for sampled pools, an independent Torch computation of the pool formula. It passes only if the reference is finite, non-zero, distinct and matches the independent pools, the legacy ring corrupts pools on the reported counterexample and on the random schedule, and the E31 ring corrupts none. scripts/tests/test-e31-kpool-tail-ring.py proves the index arithmetic offline and runs the leaf's schedules and geometry through the simulation.

tail_ring.idea: the speculative-decoding compressor ring of vllm#58454, also ported by RiNGSiDE

provenance.note: Both ideas are reimplemented for this repository's pooled indexer; no upstream file is vendored.

not_included: Fusing the indexer projections for prefill, and any other indexer change.
promotion_note: Pools already built by speculative decode with the legacy four-slot tail can be wrong and SparkCache may have stored them; a promotion of the tail ring needs a new SparkCache namespace.
